title: Sengoku Komachi Kurotan
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Shizuko Ayanokoji, a history-loving student at an agricultural high school, is suddenly transported back to the Sengoku period and captured by Oda Nobunaga's army; she vows to prove her farming expertise to him (emaqi blurb via AniList). MangaUpdates tags describe her using modern knowledge to improve farming, villages and invention in an alternate history, alongside war and strategy. An ongoing seinen adaptation of a web novel; the English release is from emaqi.
life_message: It holds up practical knowledge, hard work and making yourself useful as the way to survive and improve the world.
